TOOLING BURST T4l — burst_v2 lap 3: the fire burns back to its core (Run C-5; conductor design correction R-C5-31 after T4k's honest FAILED — T4k was right: the ring is what centre-out erosion + bright-first dissolve produce by construction). task_id "T4l".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a and T4h (with its lap-2 clause and the lap-3 clause below, added by the conductor).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (piece_burst_v2 emission: expansion, erosion schedule, residue, dissolve), export/vfx_material.gdshader (erode compares distance_value < erode; dissolve by band thresholds), export/effect_kit.py (dissolve_order, pieces phase fields), runs/C-5/t3/T4k/diagnosis.json + README.md (your own trace: at age 30 bands 0 and 1 survive together while 2/3 are dissolved, and the core erodes first), tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered bakes are the conductor's).

THE DESIGN (T4h lap-3 clause): a fire impact flares out, then BURNS BACK toward its core, and the core dims to embers at the impact point. Therefore, for template burst_v2 (v1 and the six kits untouched, byte-identical): (1) EROSION DIRECTION = outside-in — pixels far from the burst centre on the whole-body distance field erode FIRST (tips first, roots and core last): invert the comparison for v2 (`erode_outside_in` shader/kit flag; the shared shader keeps its legacy branch bit-exact for erode_outside_in=false); the tongues recede toward the centre over the erosion phase; (2) the RESIDUE is the innermost 15–25 % of peak coverage (the core + tongue roots), held for residue_s at the impact point, and during the residue phase the DISSOLVE dims it core-to-embers: bands removed in the order 3 (white), 2 (orange), then 1 and 0 together at release (`dissolve_order` [[3],[2],[1,0]] applied ONLY within the residue phase; during expansion and erosion dissolve stays 0); (3) no dark ring: at every age the surviving pixels form a compact region around the centre (largest component ≥ 0.9 of coverage; the centroid of coverage stays within 0.15 × peak extent of the origin from the start of erosion onward); (4) residue fraction measured against PEAK coverage (the max over the hold frames, not the temporal maximum during expansion) — state the denominator in the acceptance.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): a CPU replay of the v2 schedule on the T4e-r1 pieces — coverage centroid distance and largest-component fraction per age (≥ 0.9 from erosion start), residue fraction in [0.15, 0.25] of hold-peak coverage, tip pixels erode before root pixels (monotone in distance); legacy hash table for the six kits + v1 unchanged; a headless clock trace exit 0 with the new uniforms logged per age.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4l/acceptance.json; rendered = conductor's, mark UNEVALUABLE in-sandbox): the CPU numbers above; legacy byte-identity; headless import exit 0; in-sandbox suite reds named.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any test file except the two named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4l/ and runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4l/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4l"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
